PRIVACY & TRANSPARENCY

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 26 November 2026

This policy explains how The Poster Wala website may handle information when you use its online poster maker, document tools, Google sign-in, purchases and custom design services.

Information involved

When you sign in with Google, the authentication provider may supply your account identifier, name, email address and profile photo. Our site may store account and sign-in records to provide access and prevent misuse.

When you purchase a plan or download, transaction references, payment status, plan entitlements and download history may be processed or recorded. Online checkout is provided through Razorpay; card and payment information entered in the checkout is handled under the payment provider's own privacy terms.

Website analytics and visitor-count features may process event and usage information, including browser storage identifiers, to understand site usage and troubleshoot services. Browser cookies or local storage can also support sign-in and saved preferences.

Uploaded photos, posters and PDFs

Several document/photo tools process selected files locally in your browser, as stated on the individual tool page. This does not mean that every third-party resource or every website feature is offline. Use only files you are authorized to process, and read each tool's limitations. Custom design enquiries sent by email naturally share the attachments you choose to send with the recipient email service.

Third-party services

Our website uses or integrates with Google/Firebase authentication, Google analytics or advertising technology where enabled, Cloudflare-hosted services, and Razorpay checkout. External links (for example to custom design profiles or third-party tools) lead to services with their own policies. If Google advertising is activated, Google and its partners may use cookies or identifiers for ad delivery and measurement, subject to applicable consent requirements and Google policies.

Why information is used

To authenticate users, provide downloads and paid access, operate customer support, secure services, investigate abuse, maintain financial records required for transactions and improve site reliability.

Storage, retention and security

Information may be retained in connected providers and service databases for as long as reasonably needed to operate the service, handle support, fulfill legal/accounting obligations or resolve disputes. We use service and account access controls; no online system can guarantee absolute security. Do not upload confidential information to a tool unless its operation and privacy notice suit your needs.

Your choices and requests

You can sign out, change browser storage settings and contact us about the personal information associated with your account or a purchase. Some transaction or audit records may need to be retained for legal or accounting reasons. To request access, correction or deletion where applicable, email dhaliwalballi18@gmail.com. Please do not send passwords or sensitive identification scans without a specific secure request.

Changes

We may update this policy as services change. The updated version and date will be published on this page.
